title: Correct first average
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (1) must be the arithmetic mean (v₁ + v₂)/2.

title: Correct second average
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (2) must be the harmonic mean 2v₁'v₂'/(v₁' + v₂').

title: Uses time halves definition
description: Important Criteria: For part (1), the solution must define total displacement as the sum of displacements in two equal time intervals.

title: Uses displacement halves definition
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the solution must define total time as the sum of times for two equal displacements.

title: Clear variable definitions
description: Optional Criteria: The response clearly defines symbols for time intervals or displacements before applying formulas.

title: Confuses average formulas
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the arithmetic mean for part (2) or harmonic mean for part (1).

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional Criteria: The final expressions are simplified and clearly presented.
